meta.name: playwright-cli
meta.description: Automate browser interactions, test web pages and work with Playwright tests.

copy.tagline: 自动化浏览器交互与网页测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码操控浏览器并验证网页行为
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and test web pages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically and verify web page behavior

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以通过 playwright-cli 命令打开真实浏览器,执行打开网页、点击、输入、截图、保存为 PDF、管理标签页、拦截网络请求等操作,并在每次命令后返回页面的可交互快照。
howto.when: 当用户要求打开网页、点击元素,或运行/调试 Playwright 测试等浏览器相关任务时触发。

say.text: 打开 https://example.com 并截个图
say.note: Claude 会启动浏览器访问页面并保存截图。

say.text: 点击页面上叫“Login”的按钮,然后填邮箱
say.note: Claude 会用快照定位元素并执行点击、输入。

say.text: 帮我运行 Playwright 测试并给出结果
say.note: Claude 会执行相关测试命令并汇报。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can drive a real browser via playwright-cli: open pages, click, type, screenshot, save as PDF, manage tabs, mock network requests, and get an interactive snapshot after each command.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for browser operations (opening pages, clicking elements) or running/debugging Playwright tests.

say_en.text: Open https://example.com and take a screenshot
say_en.note: Claude will launch a browser, visit the page, and save a screenshot.

say_en.text: Click the button named 'Login', then fill in the email
say_en.note: Claude will locate the element from the snapshot and perform the actions.

say_en.text: Run the Playwright tests and report the results
say_en.note: Claude will execute the test commands and summarize the output.
